purpose: Curated authoritative discovery registry for VISUAL. Entries are research leads, not blanket permission to download, redistribute, or train on content.

sources.name: Global Biodiversity Information Facility
sources.access_mode: REST API; paged queries and asynchronous downloads
sources.license_policy: Per-dataset license varies; record-level CC0, CC BY and CC BY-NC may occur. Preserve attribution and exclude non-commercial material from commercial training.
sources.download_policy: metadata_first; bulk download only after dataset filters, license manifest and citation are checked
quality_notes: Taxonomic synonym and identifier reconciliation required
Occurrence records can have geospatial, temporal and identification uncertainty
GBIF disclaims guarantee of source-data accuracy

sources.name: Ocean Biodiversity Information System
sources.access_mode: REST API for smaller subsets; GeoParquet exports for large subsets
sources.license_policy: The integrated export is CC BY-NC; underlying source datasets can differ. Inspect the source license manifest before any reuse.
sources.download_policy: do_not_parallelize_bulk_downloads; use documented export method and preserve per-source licenses
quality_notes: OBIS runs initial, automated and manual quality control
Keep provider fields and OBIS-derived QC fields distinguishable

sources.name: Museum für Naturkunde Berlin Animal Sound Archive
sources.access_mode: Archive discovery and GBIF-linked metadata; audio access subject to archive terms
sources.license_policy: GBIF occurrence dataset is listed CC BY 4.0; do not infer that every linked audio file has identical rights. Verify each recording's terms with the archive.
sources.download_policy: no audio bulk download until recording-level permission and license are confirmed
quality_notes: Separate wild recordings from zoo or experimental recordings
Preserve original sample rate, bit depth, recording context and taxon identifier

sources.name: Xeno-canto wildlife sound recordings
sources.access_mode: API v3; API key required
sources.license_policy: License is selected per recording; many recordings are non-commercial or share-alike. Evaluate every recording individually; exclude NC and ND from commercial training.
sources.download_policy: metadata only until key and API terms are configured; audio reuse only after per-recording license review
quality_notes: Do not expose precise locations for sensitive or threatened species
Retain recordist attribution, recording quality, date, location precision and vocalization type

sources.name: iNaturalist observations and media
sources.access_mode: curated exports and documented API; not bulk scraping
sources.license_policy: Observation records and media carry varying licenses. Dataset exports include CC0, CC BY and CC BY-NC observations; filter per record and media asset.
sources.download_policy: prefer official exports; respect API media rate limits; do not assume observation license covers linked media
quality_notes: Presence-only observations have sampling and observer bias
Preserve geoprivacy and obscured-location rules
Identifications may change over time

sources.name: OpenNeuro
sources.access_mode: public dataset browser, documented command-line/API and DataLad workflows
sources.license_policy: OpenNeuro submissions are required to use CC0; still verify the dataset snapshot and accompanying participant/privacy constraints before processing.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; no human-subject bulk data download until privacy, consent, defacing, BIDS validation and storage checks pass
quality_notes: Use BIDS validation
Preserve dataset version and DOI
Neuroimaging is not a direct measurement of intelligence or a clinical diagnosis

sources.name: Neuroelectromagnetic Data Archive and Tools Resource
sources.access_mode: dataset discovery and per-dataset access
sources.license_policy: Dataset licenses vary, including public-domain, attribution, non-commercial, no-derivatives and custom/unknown. Filter each dataset individually.
sources.download_policy: no automated bulk download; use public-license filters and dataset-level terms
quality_notes: Preserve event annotations, channel metadata, montage and quality information
Human-subject privacy and consent review required

sources.name: Allen Institute Brain Map and Cell Atlas
sources.access_mode: documented API, SDK and project-specific downloads
sources.license_policy: Allen Institute Terms of Use and citation policy apply; do not label all content CC0 or assume commercial reuse permission.
sources.download_policy: metadata and code examples first; verify applicable terms and citation policy per resource
quality_notes: Record species, brain region, assay, developmental stage and experimental protocol

sources.name: NASA Earthdata
sources.access_mode: NASA Common Metadata Repository and product-specific services
sources.license_policy: Many NASA datasets are openly accessible, but product-specific notices, third-party content and access credentials may apply. Check each product record.
sources.download_policy: product-level review, spatial/temporal subset and checksum before download
quality_notes: Record sensor, collection version, processing level, calibration and uncertainty

sources.name: Hugging Face Datasets Hub
data_types: text, image, audio and video dataset references
sources.access_mode: Hub API and dataset cards
sources.license_policy: Dataset licenses and upstream provenance vary. A public Hub listing is not evidence that every file is legally reusable.
sources.download_policy: metadata only until dataset card, upstream source, license, privacy and file manifest are reviewed
quality_notes: Check train/test contamination, benchmark leakage, duplicates, personal data and dataset-card completeness

sources.name: Zenodo
sources.access_mode: REST API and record files
sources.license_policy: License is record- and file-specific. Check the deposited record and every file; do not assume a repository-wide license.
sources.download_policy: record metadata first; download only after file-level license and checksum verification
quality_notes: Record DOI, version, creators, publication date, related identifiers and file checksums

sources.name: PubMed
sources.access_mode: NCBI E-utilities
sources.license_policy: Bibliographic metadata access does not grant reuse rights to article abstracts, full text, figures or supplementary data. Check publisher and PMC license status.
sources.download_policy: metadata-first; full text only from sources with explicit reuse permissions
quality_notes: Retain PMID, DOI, publication type, retraction/correction status and publication date

sources.name: OpenAlex
sources.access_mode: REST API and snapshot
sources.license_policy: OpenAlex metadata is CC0; linked full text has separate rights and must be reviewed independently.
sources.download_policy: metadata API first; do not mirror linked papers without their own license check
quality_notes: Disambiguate authors and institutions; record work identifiers and metadata update time

sources.name: Crossref
sources.access_mode: REST API
sources.license_policy: Bibliographic metadata is CC0; abstracts and full text may have separate rights. Do not ingest abstracts based on metadata license alone.
sources.download_policy: metadata-only
quality_notes: Normalize DOI, preserve deposited dates and correction/retraction relations

sources.name: Wikidata
sources.access_mode: documented APIs and dumps
sources.license_policy: Structured data is CC0; linked media and external descriptions may carry separate licenses.
sources.download_policy: respect API policy; preserve references and statement qualifiers
quality_notes: Statements can be disputed, incomplete or time-dependent; retain references and retrieval timestamp

sources.name: DANDI Archive
sources.access_mode: DANDI API and versioned asset downloads
sources.license_policy: Dataset and asset-level licenses and consents must be checked; human and animal research data may carry additional restrictions.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; download only public versioned assets after license, consent, checksum and storage review
quality_notes: Preserve NWB schema and DANDI version identifier
Validate subject/session metadata and privacy constraints

sources.name: NASA Open Science Data Repository
sources.access_mode: NASA OSDR search, metadata and data-file APIs
sources.license_policy: Check each study, file, third-party contribution and data-use condition; remove or protect sensitive participant information.
sources.download_policy: metadata search first; select study files after rights, privacy and checksum review
quality_notes: Record study accession, assay, organism, mission and experimental conditions
Preserve raw and processed data distinctions

sources.name: Brain Image Library
sources.access_mode: Public dataset discovery and repository-specific downloads
sources.license_policy: Review dataset-specific license, consent, attribution and specimen provenance.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; large imaging downloads require storage preflight and manifest/checksum validation
quality_notes: Preserve voxel dimensions, orientation, modality, staining and acquisition metadata
Distinguish species, brain region and developmental stage

sources.name: OpenNeuro PET
sources.access_mode: Public dataset archive and documented access methods
sources.license_policy: Verify dataset snapshot license, participant consent, de-identification and any data-use limitations individually.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; no bulk download before privacy, license and BIDS checks
quality_notes: Record tracer, acquisition protocol, scanner, preprocessing and BIDS validation status

sources.name: Earth Species Project alp-data
sources.access_mode: Python package with per-dataset loaders; dataset-specific upstream access
sources.license_policy: Each upstream dataset retains its own license and terms; inspect per-dataset documentation before download or training.
sources.download_policy: No blanket bulk mirror; use per-dataset loader only after upstream rights and checksums verified
quality_notes: Preserve upstream dataset identity and original annotations
Check subject, site and recording-session leakage
Validate sample rate, channel count and duration

sources.name: Bioacoustics datasets index
sources.access_mode: Curated index; follow original dataset repositories
sources.license_policy: Index entry does not establish underlying dataset license; inspect original repository and recording-level terms.
sources.download_policy: Harvest catalog metadata only; download original datasets only after item-level license and access checks
quality_notes: Check taxonomic coverage and annotation quality
Record recording hours and geographic coverage
Avoid mixing benchmark test sets into training

sources.name: Collaborative Research in Computational Neuroscience
sources.access_mode: Dataset-specific repository access and data-use terms
sources.license_policy: Terms and data-use agreements vary by dataset; do not assume open commercial reuse.
sources.download_policy: Metadata-first; honor registration and dataset-specific agreement
quality_notes: Preserve experimental protocol, species, task, electrode metadata and labels
Check subject/session splits and data-use restrictions

sources.name: NeuroTycho
sources.access_mode: Dataset portal and dataset-specific download terms
sources.license_policy: Verify portal and dataset-specific reuse conditions; animal neural data are not automatically CC0.
sources.download_policy: No automatic downloads until access and license terms are verified
quality_notes: Preserve sampling rate, channel layout, task events and animal/session identity

sources.name: FAO AGRIS Open Data Set
sources.access_mode: Open Data Set download and catalog metadata
sources.license_policy: AGRIS ODS metadata is CC BY 4.0; linked full texts retain their own licenses.
sources.download_policy: Metadata may be reused with attribution; inspect linked article and dataset rights separately
quality_notes: Preserve Dublin Core and Data Catalog fields
Normalize DOI and institutional identifiers
Do not infer rights for linked full text

sources.name: World Resources Institute Data Explorer
sources.access_mode: Dataset catalog and per-dataset downloads
sources.license_policy: Check each dataset's license, attribution and source terms individually.
sources.download_policy: Metadata first; download only after per-dataset terms and file manifest are verified
quality_notes: Record spatial and temporal resolution, units, methodology and uncertainty

sources.name: UN Biodiversity Lab
sources.access_mode: Dataset catalog and provider-specific geospatial layers
sources.license_policy: Licenses vary by data provider and layer; verify each layer's reuse terms.
sources.download_policy: Catalog metadata first; obtain layer-specific terms before downloads
quality_notes: Retain provider, spatial resolution, projection and version
Respect restricted national workspaces and sensitive species locations

sources.name: World Health Organization Global Health Observatory
sources.access_mode: WHO GHO OData API and downloadable indicator datasets
sources.license_policy: WHO data terms and third-party source conditions apply; inspect indicator-level attribution and reuse notices; no personal health records.
sources.download_policy: metadata and aggregate indicators first; download only with explicit terms and source attribution
quality_notes: Record indicator definition, unit, population, geography, time coverage and revision date
Do not compare indicators without checking methodology and age standardization

sources.name: World Bank Open Data
sources.access_mode: Indicators API, DataBank and bulk downloads
sources.license_policy: Many World Bank datasets use CC BY 4.0, but exceptions and third-party data exist; check each dataset's license and attribution.
sources.download_policy: query metadata and indicator subsets first; retain source and indicator metadata
quality_notes: Preserve indicator codes, units, country codes, time series and source notes
Missing values are not zero; record imputation only as derived data

sources.name: FAOSTAT
sources.access_mode: FAOSTAT API and downloadable data domains
sources.license_policy: FAO statistical data reuse and attribution terms apply; verify current FAO open-data license and third-party restrictions for each dataset.
sources.download_policy: use API domain/area/item subsets; preserve FAO metadata and attribution
quality_notes: Keep element, item, area, year, unit and flags
Check revisions, estimates and country reporting gaps

sources.name: UNESCO Institute for Statistics
sources.access_mode: UIS API and downloadable statistical datasets
sources.license_policy: Check UIS data terms and metadata for attribution and third-party source restrictions before redistribution or training.
sources.download_policy: metadata and indicator subsets first; preserve definitions and provenance
quality_notes: Check indicator methodology and national reporting differences
Do not infer missing country-year values

sources.name: WIPO PATENTSCOPE and IP statistics
sources.access_mode: PATENTSCOPE search and WIPO statistical data services
sources.license_policy: Patent documents are public records but database access, bulk extraction, images and third-party content have separate terms; do not scrape or redistribute outside permitted channels.
sources.download_policy: use permitted search/export facilities; metadata only unless bulk access is explicitly authorized
quality_notes: Preserve publication number, family, priority date, IPC/CPC codes and jurisdiction
Patent claims are legal documents, not proof of technical validity

sources.name: International Labour Organization ILOSTAT
sources.access_mode: ILOSTAT API and bulk statistical files
sources.license_policy: Check ILOSTAT reuse, citation and third-party source notices for each dataset; preserve source and metadata.
sources.download_policy: use documented bulk/API access with indicator subsets; retain metadata and methodology
quality_notes: Keep ISCO/industry classifications, units, population and survey method
Separate modelled estimates from national observed statistics

sources.name: NVIDIA TensorRT Documentation
sources.access_mode: official documentation and code samples
sources.license_policy: Documentation and SDK components have NVIDIA-specific terms; check each software license before redistribution or use.
sources.download_policy: documentation metadata and selected pages; respect product and software licenses
quality_notes: Record TensorRT, CUDA, driver, GPU and precision versions
Benchmark on target hardware; do not generalize vendor performance claims

sources.name: RISC-V Ratified Specifications
sources.access_mode: official ratified specifications and versioned PDFs
sources.license_policy: Specification copyright and trademark notices apply; retain version and terms when storing copies.
sources.download_policy: index specification metadata and permitted documents; preserve ratification status and version
quality_notes: Distinguish ratified specifications from drafts
Record ISA extension and profile versions exactly

sources.name: ROS 2 Documentation
sources.access_mode: official documentation, package APIs and versioned distributions
sources.license_policy: Documentation and package licenses differ; verify per repository/package before copying code.
sources.download_policy: index docs and package metadata; preserve ROS distribution and package version
quality_notes: Record distro, middleware, RMW implementation and hardware platform
Separate simulation evidence from physical robot tests

sources.name: MoveIt 2 Documentation
sources.access_mode: official docs, tutorials, concepts and API references
sources.license_policy: Documentation and source repositories carry their own license notices; verify before redistribution.
sources.download_policy: documentation metadata and selected permitted examples
quality_notes: Record ROS 2 distro, MoveIt version, robot model and planning pipeline
Validate collision models, frames, limits and controller interface

sources.name: NVIDIA Isaac ROS
sources.access_mode: official docs, repositories, package releases and example workflows
sources.license_policy: Each repository, package, model and dataset has its own license and terms; inspect before use.
sources.download_policy: metadata first; selected packages after hardware compatibility and license review
quality_notes: Record Jetson/GPU, JetPack, CUDA, ROS 2 and Isaac ROS versions
Keep throughput and latency benchmarks tied to exact device and workload

sources.name: CERN Open Data Portal
sources.access_mode: Dataset catalogue and downloadable experiment releases; formats and software vary by experiment and data level
sources.license_policy: Use each dataset's stated open license, DOI, citation and collaboration conditions; preserve required software environment and provenance.
sources.download_policy: Index metadata first; bulk event data only after storage, dataset-level license, software dependencies and checksum/manifest review.
quality_notes: Distinguish education, analysis and full research data levels
Retain experiment, run, detector, trigger, calibration and simulation metadata
Large datasets require experiment-specific analysis software

sources.name: HEPData
sources.access_mode: Searchable repository and record-level downloads/API
sources.license_policy: Check record-level license and citation; preserve publication DOI and table-level metadata.
sources.download_policy: Collect record metadata and table manifests first; download reusable records with attribution and rate limits.
quality_notes: Preserve statistical and systematic uncertainties separately
Retain binning, units, covariance and analysis notes
Do not flatten multi-dimensional tables into untyped text

sources.name: Gravitational Wave Open Science Center
sources.access_mode: Public catalogue, API and event/segment data downloads
sources.license_policy: Follow GWOSC data-use and citation guidance; preserve detector, observing run, calibration version and data quality.
sources.download_policy: Start with event metadata and selected event windows; large strain archives require storage preflight and checksums.
quality_notes: Preserve sample rate, GPS time, detector identity and calibration
Keep injection, noise and astrophysical event labels distinct
Record data-quality vetoes and observing-run version

sources.name: NASA Astrophysics Data System
sources.access_mode: Search API and bibliographic metadata; full-text rights vary by linked publisher/repository
sources.license_policy: Respect ADS API terms and the rights of linked full text; metadata reuse and article reuse are not interchangeable.
sources.download_policy: Use API metadata and open-access links; do not mirror publisher full text without a valid license.
quality_notes: Preserve bibcode, DOI, arXiv identifier and publication status
Deduplicate preprint and journal versions without losing version links

sources.name: NIST Physical Measurement and Reference Data
sources.access_mode: Curated reference databases, tables and documented services
sources.license_policy: Check each NIST database's terms, citation and any third-party notices; record retrieval date and dataset version.
sources.download_policy: Prefer structured tables and documented endpoints; preserve units, uncertainty, conditions and reference citations.
quality_notes: Never strip units or uncertainty from physical constants
Store temperature, pressure, isotope and measurement conditions
Track recommended values separately from historical measurements

sources.name: Materials Project
sources.access_mode: Documented API and dataset downloads; account/API key may be required
sources.license_policy: Follow Materials Project terms, attribution and API policies; preserve calculation provenance and upstream data rights.
sources.download_policy: Metadata first; use bounded queries and download only selected records after terms, rate limits and storage checks.
quality_notes: Keep calculation settings, functional, convergence and source identifiers
Distinguish computed predictions from experimental measurements

sources.name: NOMAD Laboratory
sources.access_mode: Repository search and API; record-level archives
sources.license_policy: Check entry-level access and license metadata and cite original data producers.
sources.download_policy: Index archive metadata first; download selected open entries only with provenance, checksums and storage preflight.
quality_notes: Preserve code, version, input parameters and workflow provenance
Validate parsed quantities and units against original calculation files

sources.name: UKAEA FAIR-MAST Open Data
sources.access_mode: Open data portal and documented FAIR-MAST data access
sources.license_policy: Verify each campaign/record license and citation; respect access policy and data provider attribution.
sources.download_policy: Begin with shot metadata and selected diagnostics; bulk time-series downloads require per-campaign license, byte-size and checksum review.
quality_notes: Retain shot number, diagnostic, channel, units and time base
Keep calibration and missing-data masks
Do not merge different machine campaigns without schema mapping

sources.name: Particle Data Group Review of Particle Physics
sources.access_mode: Public review pages, tables and downloadable reference material
sources.license_policy: Preserve PDG citation and review edition; verify terms before redistributing complete tables or documents.
sources.download_policy: Collect bibliographic metadata and structured reference tables where permitted; store edition/year with every value.
quality_notes: Record confidence level, uncertainty convention and fit assumptions
Do not mix values from different PDG editions without version labels

sources.name: IceCube Neutrino Observatory Open Data
sources.access_mode: Release-specific downloadable datasets and documentation
sources.license_policy: Check release-specific data-use and citation requirements; preserve collaboration documentation and selection definitions.
sources.download_policy: Use explicitly released samples; no scraping of internal collaboration data; verify size, checksum and analysis software.
quality_notes: Keep event selection, detector configuration and livetime metadata
Separate simulated and observed events
Preserve background estimates and systematic uncertainties

sources.name: IAEA LiveChart of Nuclides / ENSDF
sources.access_mode: CSV REST API; fields=ground_states,levels,gammas,decay_rads,fission yields
sources.license_policy: Preserve IAEA source attribution and release/retrieval context; check field-specific reuse guidance
sources.download_policy: Bounded nuclide or ground-state queries; preserve extraction date, units, uncertainties and ENSDF references
quality_notes: Evaluated nuclear data, not raw detector measurements
Distinguish ground states, metastable states, decay branches and radiation types

sources.name: IceCube IceTracks-DR2
sources.access_mode: Harvard Dataverse DOI dataset API and per-file download
sources.license_policy: IceTracks-DR2 dataset CC0 1.0; retain DOI citation and version
sources.download_policy: Select event-season files, readme, uptime and IRFs; do not claim complete release unless all 41 files are verified
quality_notes: Release spans 2008-2022 and is intended for time-integrated point-source searches
Do not combine with IceTracks-DR1
Preserve version, event selection, detector configuration and livetime

sources.name: ESA Gaia Data Release 3
sources.access_mode: ESA TAP/ADQL query and CSV/VOTable results
sources.license_policy: Follow Gaia archive acknowledgement and data-use policy; preserve DR version and query
sources.download_policy: Bounded ADQL queries with explicit row limits; preserve coordinate frame, units, flags and query
quality_notes: Catalogue subset is not raw telescope telemetry
Parallax and astrometric solution quality flags must be retained

sources.name: NIST Atomic Spectra Database
sources.access_mode: Documented CGI search form with ASCII, CSV or tab-delimited output
sources.license_policy: NIST ASD terms; cite database version and retrieval date; verify reuse terms
sources.download_policy: Query spectra and wavelength ranges; no blanket full-database mirror
quality_notes: Preserve observed vs Ritz wavelength distinction
Keep units, uncertainty, transition classifications and references

sources.name: Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST)
sources.access_mode: MAST REST API and astroquery.mast; public products can be retrieved anonymously
sources.license_policy: Mission/product-specific rights and acknowledgement; preserve proposal, instrument, calibration pipeline and product version
sources.download_policy: Query public products; download only bounded selected files after checking size and product rights
quality_notes: Observation metadata is not equivalent to the science image/spectrum payload
Preserve calibration and instrument context

sources.name: Materials Project via OPTIMADE
sources.access_mode: Materials Project API key for primary API; public OPTIMADE endpoint for bounded structure queries
sources.license_policy: Verify current provider and record-level license and citation; retain calculation provenance
sources.download_policy: Use public OPTIMADE subset without credentials; full Materials Project API requires user API key
quality_notes: OPTIMADE structure subset is not a full Materials Project property database
Preserve functional, calculation settings, convergence and provenance

quality_gates: No record is training-eligible until item-level license, attribution, privacy and consent checks pass.
Do not combine metadata license with linked file license.
Validate schema, identifiers, dates, units, taxonomic names and coordinate ranges.
Keep raw immutable source metadata separate from normalized fields and derived labels.
Store source URL, accessed timestamp, version, license evidence and SHA-256 for every downloaded file.
Deduplicate exact hashes and flag near-duplicates; do not discard provenance when merging.
Split ML data by subject, individual, recording session, site or source group as appropriate to prevent leakage.
Use independent human review for ambiguous labels and sensitive biological or clinical interpretation.
For animal audio, preserve sample rate, channels, duration, recorder, habitat, weather, distance, species confidence and vocalization context.
For human neuroscience/clinical data, enforce consent, de-identification, data-use agreements and access controls.
Treat missing, contradictory or uncertain metadata as unknown; never infer a permissive license or ground-truth label.
